page.title: Bitcoin (BTC) News Today: Why BTC Is Down – 11 November 2026
page.excerpt: Bitcoin news today centers on a second week of selling that pushed the price to its lowest level since July, with the asset trading at $63,064.88 and down 2.64% over 24 hours. Bitcoin is down 14.66% over seven days, and the market has not yet found a floor above the $62,000 area.
page.excerpt_source: verbatim relay by the model of a passage of the page text Otari's fetch tool returned

excerpt_check.method: runs of six words against our own GET of the page, title words not counted

input.intent: Get current USD prices for bitcoin, ethereum, and solana

bull.claim: Negative funding: shorts are paying, crowded short side
Price near Bollinger lower band (%B<0.1): oversold

bear.claim: Price up but MACD negative: bearish divergence
Price below both EMAs: confirmed downtrend
